title: ctenitis decurrenti-pinnata
intro: Ctenitis decurrenti-pinnata, commonly known as the Aspidium decurrentipinnatum, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a perennial plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asian countries, for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis decurrenti-pinnata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
